scheme.name: CMA Syllabus 2022
scheme.notes: Built from the ICMAI "CMA Syllabus 2022" PDF supplied by the founder (effective from the June 2023 exam term). Chapters are the syllabus modules, topics are the numbered sub-items, and each chapter carries its Section and weightage in "section". Chapter marks are the module weights from the syllabus table (weight source "official"). Where the table gives one combined weight for a group of modules, or only the section total, the remaining section weight is split evenly across those modules and marked "analysis" (indicative only). Needs editor review before publishing.
